फा. सं. बीएस XI/04/03/2025-26.— भारतीय मानक ब्यूरो अजधजनयम, 2016 (2016 का 11) की धारा 5  के 
साथ पठित  धारा 39 द्वारा प्रित्त िजियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, तथा केंद्र सरकार की पूर्व स्ट्र्ीकृजत से, यह ब्यूरो एतद्वारा 
भारतीय मानक ब्यूरो (सलाहकार सजमजत) जर्जनयम, 2018 में संिोधन करने हेतु जनम्नजलजखत जर्जनयम बनाता है, अथावत्— 
1. (1) इन जर्जनयमों को भारतीय मानक ब्यूरो (सलाहकार सजमजत) संिोधन जर्जनयम, 2026 कहा िाएगा। 
(2) ये जर्जनयम इस अजधसूचना के आजधकाठरक रािपत्र में प्रकािन की जतजथ से लागू होंगे।  
2.   भारतीय मानक ब्यूरो (सलाहकार सजमजत) जर्जनयम, 2018, जर्जनयम 5 के जलए, उप-जर्जनयम (1) के जलए 
जनम्नजलजखत प्रजतस्ट्थाजपत दकया िाएगा, अथावत्:—  
“अनुरूपता मूल्यांकन सलाहकार सजमजत में जनम्नजलजखत सिस्ट्य होंगे, अथावत्:— 
(i) ब्यूरो के महाजनिेिक — अध्यक्ष; 
(ii) जनम्नजलजखत में से प्रत्येक से न्यूनतम संयुि सजचर् या समकक्ष स्ट्तर का एक प्रजतजनजध —”

BUREAU OF INDIAN STANDARDS   
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 10th April, 2026 
 
F. No. BS XI/04/03/2025-26.— In exercise of the powers conferred by section 39 read with section 5 of the 
Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016 (11 of 2016), the Bureau, with previous approval of the Central Government, 
hereby makes the following regulations further to amend the Bureau of Indian Standards (Advisory Committee) 
Regulations, 2018, namely:—  
1. (1) These regulations may be called the Bureau of Indian Standards (Advisory Committee) Amendment  
Regulations, 2026. 
 
(2) They shall come into force on the date of publication of this notification in the Official Gazette.  
2. In the Bureau of Indian Standards (Advisory Committee) Regulations, 2018, for regulation 5, for sub-regulation (1), 
following shall be substituted, namely:— 
“The Conformity Assessment Advisory Committee shall consist of the following members, namely: — 
(i) Director General of the Bureau - Chairman; 
(ii) one representative not below the rank of Joint Secretary or equivalent from each of the following– 
(a)  Department dealing with Trade Policy (World Trade Organisation or Technical Barriers to Trade) in the 
Ministry of Commerce and Industry; 
(b)  Ministry of Steel; 
(c)  Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade; 
(d)  Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises; 
(e)  Department of Consumer Affairs in the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution; 
(f)  
Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology. 
(iii) two representatives from Industry, Trade and their Associations; 
(iv) one representative from any recognised consumer organisation; 
(v) any other member as nominated by the Chairman; 
(vi) Deputy Director General (Certification) of the Bureau - Member-Secretary.” 
 
ALKA, Secy. 
[ADVT.-III/4/Exty./12/2026-27] 
 
Note: The principal regulations were published in the Gazette of India Extraordinary, Part III, Section 4 vide  
F. No. BS/11/04/2018 dated the 7th June, 2018 and subsequently amended vide F. No. BS/11/04/2018 dated the 
12th October, 2018, F. No. BS/11/04/2018 dated the 12th June 2020 and F. No. BS/11/04/2018 dated the  
13th September 2023.
